entities.name: Abzan Houses
entities.description: One of the five clans of Tarkir, resilient desert warriors who admire the dragons' aspect of endurance and draw power from ancestral spirits.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane of the five clans.

entities.name: Arashin
entities.description: The fortress city at the center of the Abzan clan.

entities.name: Shifting Wastes
entities.description: The harsh rugged desert plains that are the Abzan homeland.

entities.name: Kin-Trees
entities.description: Sacred fruit-bearing trees that house a family's ancestral spirits.

entities.name: Council of Houses
entities.description: The body that leads the reformed Abzan, with a representative from each major house and the Abzan Khan.

entities.name: Yathan
entities.description: Elite Abzan scouts, assassins and soldiers who operate independently.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: The dragonlord who massacred the Abzan, banned necromancy and razed the Kin-Trees until her defeat.

entities.name: Daghatar
entities.description: The Abzan khan who shattered the Remembrance relic and surrendered his clan to Dromoka.

entities.name: Reyhan
entities.description: The khan of the "true" Abzan, killed at the meeting of khans.

entities.name: Felothar
entities.description: Head of House Zanhar and Reyhan's descendant, chosen khan after rebelling against Dromoka.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: A valiant khan in the original timeline and, in the new timeline, a defector killed by Dromoka who found the Kin-Tree remains.

entities.name: Remembrance
entities.description: An amber relic, last remnant of the first kin-tree holding the spirits of the first ancestors, shattered by Daghatar.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who saved Ugin's life and sent him into slumber in 3279 AR.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The dragon sent into a deep slumber, which increased the dragonstorms.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A dragonlord who attacked the meeting of khans.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A dragonlord who attacked the meeting of khans.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which even Dromoka's defenses failed and the Abzan rebellion gained steam.

entities.name: Ainok
entities.description: The original inhabitants of the desert who taught the Abzan how to survive.

entities.name: House Gudal
entities.description: The House of Wit, controlling water infrastructure.

entities.name: House Emesh
entities.description: The House of Courage, specializing in weaponry.

entities.name: House Mevak
entities.description: The House of Peace, master textile workers and smiths.

entities.name: House Fenzala
entities.description: The House of Hospitality, expert traders.

entities.name: House Zanhar
entities.description: The House of Grit, known for its giant Kin-Tree and dragon-hunting prowess.

entities.name: Beyza
entities.description: A djinni who leads House Zanhar.

entities.name: Krumar
entities.description: Orphans of enemies adopted by the Abzan and treated as true family.

events.summary: After Sarkhan sends Ugin into slumber in 3279 AR, Dromoka's brood commits systematic genocide against the Abzan.
events.quote: Dromoka and her brood thus laid a systematic genocide on the Abzan, to the point of utter desperation.

events.summary: Daghatar learns why Dromoka massacred his people, shatters the Remembrance and ends the kin-tree practices, forging a pact with the dragon.
events.quote: he ignored the dictates of the Remembrance spirits and shattered the relic, pleasing the dragon.

events.summary: Khan Reyhan is killed when Ojutai, Silumgar and their broods attack the meeting of khans, leaving Daghatar's people under Dromoka as survivors.
events.quote: Ojutai , Silumgar and their broods attacked the meeting, killing her

events.summary: Under Dromoka necromancy is banned and the Kin-Trees razed, but ancestor worship persists in secret.
events.quote: necromancy was banned, the Kin-Trees were razed, and all forms of ancestral communion were strictly prohibited.

events.summary: Defectors like Anafenza challenge Dromoka and are killed, but the rebellion gains steam during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: who challenged the dragonlord and were ultimately killed for their disobedience.

events.summary: The rebellion grows until Dromoka is defeated alongside the other dragonlords.
events.quote: eventually leading to Dromoka's defeat alongside the other dragonlords.

events.summary: Felothar rebels against Dromoka after the invasion and is chosen as khan.
events.quote: was chosen after rebelling against Dromoka in the aftermath of the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: Anafenza finds the remains of the nearly extinct Kin-Trees, which are revived with necromantic magic.
events.quote: In the years since, many of their remains were found by Anafenza .
